english.title: Registered early years provider fail to notify Chief Inspector of occurrence of specified event / provide information

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: The Early Years Foundation Stage Welfare Requirements Regulations 2012

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a registered early years provider under the Childcare Act 2006 failed, without reasonable excuse, to comply with the requirements of regulation 8(1) of the Early Years Foundation Stage (Welfare Requirements) Regulations 2012 by not notifying the Chief Inspector of Schools of the occurrence of an event set out in the Schedule to those Regulations, namely **(..SPECIFY THE EVENT..) and at the same time providing the Chief Inspector with the information specified in the Schedule in respect of that event in advance of the event occurring or as soon as was reasonably practicable but within 14 days beginning with the date that the event occurred
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 8(1), 8(2) and 12(1) of the Early Years Foundation Stage (Welfare Requirements) Regulations 2012.

english.notes: Regulation 12 of the Early Years Foundation Stage (Welfare Requirements) Regulations 2012 specifies proceedings for proceedings in respect of this offence may only be taken by (a) the Chief Inspector and (b) after the Chief Inspector has allowed a period not exceeding one month, beginning with the date the Chief Inspector notified the registered early years provider of the decision to take proceedings, for the registered early years provider to make representations.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant being a registered early years provider under the Childcare Act 2006 failed, without reasonable excuse, to comply with the requirements of regulation 8(1) of the Early Years Foundation Stage (Welfare Requirements) Regulations 2012 by not notifying the Chief Inspector of Schools of the occurrence of an event set out in the Schedule to those Regulations, namely **(..SPECIFY THE EVENT..) and at the same time providing the Chief Inspector with the information specified in the Schedule in respect of that event in advance of the event occurring or as soon as was reasonably practicable but within 14 days beginning with the date that the event occurred.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine notexceeding level five on the standard scale.
